_links.description: Contains links relevant to the export item.

accountingEntryLines.description: An accounting entry is represented with either a single line or multiple lines that explain the details. So, if the accounting entry is split into multiple lines, each line has a unique ID.

items.description: An accounting entry is represented with either a single line or multiple lines that explain the details. So, if the accounting entry is split into multiple lines, each line has a unique ID.

account.description: Specific General Ledger (GL) account allocated to the export item - the account code, the identifier, or both are mentioned, if any GL account is allocated.

code.description: Code.

id.description: Id.

name.description: Name.

lineAmount.description: Amount of the specific accounting entry line.

netAmount.description: Amount either including or excluding tax. This depends on the tax code, represented in the tax type attribute.

tags.description: Tags are cost centres allocated to an export item.

tax.description: Tax details applicable to this accounting entry line. The tax details usually have the code, the identifier, or both.

code.description: Code.

id.description: Id.

additionalInformation.description: Additional information applicable to this accounting entry.

items.description: Indicates attendance of participants at the time of the spend. For example, if an employee took clients to dinner, this attribute indicates who were present at the dinner.

attendeesData.description: Structured attendee data, including name and company, for participants at the time of the spend.

contacts.description: External contacts who attended the spend.

employees.description: Company employees who attended the spend.

creditNoteInformation.description: Credit note details, if applicable. Only included for credit note entries.

allocations.description: Allocations linking this credit note to one or more invoices. Can be empty if the credit note is not allocated to any invoice.

issuingDate.description: Date the credit note was issued.

invoiceInformation.description: For an invoice, additional information related to the invoice is specified in this attribute.

discountPercentage.description: The early-payment (Skonto) discount percentage applied to this payment, if any.

paymentDate.description: Date the invoice was paid if the status is paid.

status.description: This can be one of InvoiceInformationStatusV3 values

reconciledEntries.description: A list of reconciliation IDs for reimbursement expenses that are settled by this reimbursement. Only included for reimbursement transactions.

items.description: A list of reconciliation IDs for reimbursement expenses that are settled by this reimbursement. Only included for reimbursement transactions.

reconciliationId.description: Identifier used to reconcile between Pleo and the accounting system. Also known in Pleo as the book ID.

inSupplierCurrency.description: The total amount paid or owed to the supplier/vendor, in the currency the supplier/vendor operates in.

currency.description: Represents the currency code (ISO 4217) of the supplier.

value.description: Represents the amount in cents (amount/100). For example, 896.96 SEK is represented as 89696.

inWalletCurrency.description: The total amount paid or owed to the supplier/vendor, in the currency the supplier/vendor operates in.

currency.description: Represents the currency code (ISO 4217) of the supplier.

value.description: Represents the amount in cents (amount/100). For example, 896.96 SEK is represented as 89696.

bookkeeping.description: Bookkeeping related configurations for an accounting entry.

method.description: This can be one of BookkeepingMethodV3 values

date.description: The date when the export item was book kept.

files.description: Files that have been attached to this accounting entry.

items.description: Files that have been attached to this accounting entry.

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.

type.description: Type of file, usually represented similar to mime type.

note.description: Additional comments potentially describing the accounting entry.

servicePeriod.description: The period during which a service was provided, goods were delivered, or an expense was incurred.

from.description: The start of the service period in ISO 8601 datetime format.

to.description: The end of the service period in ISO 8601 datetime format.

subType.description: This can be one of ExportItemSubTypeV3 values

name.description: Name of the team.

vendor.description: The vendor associated with the accounting entry.
